# Faharia by Lauren James Li

## Canonical website
https://fahariabylaurenjamesli.github.io/faharia-book-by-lauren-james-li-free-preview/

## What this website is
This is the official author-approved free book preview website for **Faharia** by **Lauren James Li**. It presents the approved opening pages through printed page 20 and links readers to the complete book. It does not provide an unauthorized full-book download.

## Book

- Series: Faharia Trilogy, Book 1

- Print length: 279 pages

- Hardcover ISBN: 979-8-9971014-1-1
